tests.name: gen_21

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises check_bson_cstr with std::true_type (bulk contiguous span input) falling back to get_bson_cstr when the scannable input has no zero byte before length exhaustion.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises check_bson_cstr with std::false_type (non-contiguous stream input adapter) detecting ill-formed UTF-8 in an array element name in strict mode.
